system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: United States road-network feature coverage for all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, and U.S. Island Areas in the 2019 TIGER release.

data_description.data_type_numeric: Attribute schema is mixed; inspect property fields before numeric aggregation

vector_content.thematic_group: Global Utilities, Assets and Amenities Layers

property_semantics_hint.FULLNAME: Full road name string when populated.
property_semantics_hint.LINEARID: Unique linear feature identifier for the road segment.
property_semantics_hint.NAME: Core road-name field when populated separately from directional/type fields.
property_semantics_hint.RTTYP: Road-route type classification field in the TIGER schema.
property_semantics_hint.MTFCC: MAF/TIGER Feature Class Code describing the transportation feature type.
property_semantics_hint.PREDIR: Predirectional component of the road name when available.
property_semantics_hint.SUFDIR: Sufdirectional component of the road name when available.

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from an actual Earth Engine FeatureCollection probe. The runtime schema clearly exposes road-name and classification fields, but the first sampled feature had `Empty` geometry, so geometry-dependent analyses should re-sample or filter non-empty features at runtime.
analytical_capabilities: Combination with population, mining, or hazard layers

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Road-feature attributes and vector geometry; no single canonical measurement field should be assumed from the probe alone.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use schema fields such as `FULLNAME`, `LINEARID`, `RTTYP`, and `MTFCC` for attribute filtering, and validate geometry availability on sampled features before spatial analysis.

data_description.data_source: U.S. Census Bureau via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
